en: "A man-made bridge{n} across to the plateau..."
"Who could have built a bridge like thiis?"
"How should I know!"
"But going by the name Death Plateau,{n} what's on the far side of this bridge{n} might just be the land of the dead."
"The land of the dead... you say?"
"Don't take it seriously. I'm joking."
"Still, this far in, it looks like{n} no country's army has{n} made its way here."
"Which means we might be{n} the first ones heere?"
"Or maybe the first ones into hell."
"Oh, but being first is a good thing.{n} In footraces and in schoolwork toooo."
"Then let me ask you: what about{n} whoever comes in second,{n} or whoever comes in dead last?"
"Oh no, they needn't worry about iit."
"Whether you call it first or second,{n} it's never a ranking that decides{n} what that person is woorth."
"But the unbroken spirit that tries{n} hard to be first next time: that is{n} a person's true worth, I thiink."
"You say something good, once in a while."
"The 'once in a while' was uncalled foor!"
"But this far in, we really don't sense{n} soldiers from other countries{n} anymore, do wee, Mr. {hero:6}?"
"So we're the first ones in, I guess..."
"Not that being first always{n} means you come out ahead."
"Is that sooo?"
"What a win is worth differs{n} from person to person."
"There's no rank above first. Take{n} first place right off and there's{n} nowhere higher left to aim for."
"Starting out dead last is about right.{n} Then you get the fun of clawing{n} your way up."
"And what if you can't claw your way up?"
"Then that's all you ever were.{n} Nothing more to it than that."
"Oh myy? There seems to be a boy out{n} in this lonely plaace? And he{n} doesn't look like a soldier, eitheer."
"No, never let your guard down.{n} Going by age, I'm not much different{n} from that kid over there myself."
"Hello there."
"Oh, yes, yes, hellooo."
"You two are a truly lovely work of art.{n} One finished whole made of two.{n} An imbalance of clashing light and dark."
"Huuh?"
"He's spouting weird stuff{n} right off the bat."
"So, who are you?"
"So, why are you here?"
"What do you mean by that?"
"He's spouting weird stuff{n} right off the bat."
"Um, excuse me, buut..."
"Who might you beee?"
"Why are you heere?"
"What does that meaan?"
"So, who are you?"
"If humans are to call me something,{n} Ymir. Still, names to tell each{n} individual apart were a fine invention."
"So, why are you here?"
"The meaning of that question is{n} vague. I cannot answer it, and if I{n} did, it would be of little use to you."
"What's that supposed to mean?"
"Adding another meaning to a meaning{n} is a bad habit of humans.{n} I meant exactly what the words say."
"And who might you be, I wondeer?"
"If humans must call me something:{n} Ymir. Names are a useful thing{n} for telling each individual apart."
"Why are you here, I wondeer?"
"The meaning of that question is{n} vague. I cannot answer it, and if I{n} did, it would be of little use to you."
"What do you mean by thaat?"
"Adding another meaning to a meaning{n} is a bad habit of humans.{n} I meant exactly what the words say."
"Tch, what's all this babbling about?{n} Good grief. Is this brat{n} cracked in the head or what?"
"U-ummm, I haven't the faintest{n} idea what you're talking abouut?"
"Pleease look? Over there... isn't that{n} the boy we met the other daaay?"
"Tch... something's fishy here."
"Hello. We meet again."
"Yeees, so it seeems."
"Look. It's that brat again..."
"It certainly seems thaat way.{n} Is this a coincidence too, I wondeer?"
"Who knows..."
"Good day. We meet again."
"Hey, you, brat. Why have you been{n} tailing us this whole time?"
"Following you? No, you are mistaken.{n} I am the one who bears the name Ymir.{n} Your guide, so to speak."
"A guide?"
"Guide us to what?"
"What do you mean?"
"Don't screw with me!"
"A guide, you saay?"
"A guide to whaat?"
"What do you meaan?"
"How interestiing."
"And what is it you're guiding us to?"
"Not a road in the physical sense.{n} I show all living things{n} the direction toward the future."
"Heh, that makes no damn sense."
"And what's that supposed to mean?"
"Meaning is what one perceives after{n} thinking. If thought is the essence of{n} humans, you too must think for yourself."
"Heh, mind your own business."
"Heh, don't screw with me!"
"By arriving at an answer like that,{n} you make the limits of your thinking{n} all the clearer to see."
"Haah? What the hell are you on about?{n} You got a screw loose somewhere{n} in that head of yours?"
"What will you be guiding us tooo?"
"Not a road in the physical sense.{n} I show all living things{n} the direction toward the future."
"R-riight...?"
"What does that meaan?"
"Meaning is what one perceives after{n} thinking. If thought is the essence of{n} humans, you too must think for yourself."
"Yees... I'm sooorry..."
"What an interesting answeer."
"'Interesting' is a perception, too.{n} By that perception and by feeling, you{n} strive to make sense of the baffling."
"Oh myyy? That boy from before{n} is standing right over theeere?"
"A guide... that's what he said."
"Could this mean that we're the ones{n} walking to wherever that brat{n} happens to be?"
"Surely not...?"
"Hello there."
"Yeees, hellooo!"
"Hello. We really do meet often."
"But is this a coincidence, I wondeer?"
"Who knows..."
"Can you not see them?{n} The wise and orderly ones{n} who are here, there and everywhere."
"Where's anybody like that?"
"Is someone theere?"
"Hee hee. There: the hum of small insects'{n} wings, the patter of small insects' feet.{n} Listen closely and you should hear them."
"Insects?"
"Insects, you saay?"
"You see, I have always thought that{n} insects may well be the most{n} advanced life on this earth."
"Insects, as a rule, do not learn. All{n} they have are reflexes, engraved as{n} instinct, set off by their surroundings."
"Advanced life, huh..."
"Don't be stupid"
"I see"
"Don't be stupid. How can a creature{n} that's nothing but instinct{n} be called advanced life?"
"I see..."
"But that's one way of looking at things.{n} In this world there are{n} other ways to see it too."
"Advanced life, you saay..."
"Is that sooo?"
"That may be so"
"Is that sooo?"
"That is one way of thinking, but{n} I can't quite believe that{n} it's necessarily riight."
"That may well be so."
"But is there really any high or low{n} among all living thiings?"
"Yes, there are many ways of thinking."
"But you see, not learning from the{n} past may perhaps be the greatest{n} hint toward everlasting happiness."
"At the very least, they will surely{n} never create things that are{n} beyond their own control."
"Look at the bees and the ants."
"With only reflexes engraved in instinct,{n} they maintain vast swarms, build nests,{n} and efficiently leave descendants."
"They do not hesitate even to eat their{n} own kind. To keep their line going,{n} they will devour even their mates."
"If leaving offspring is the greatest{n} mission of a living thing..."
"Then could it not be said that they,{n} who stop at nothing, are the most{n} advanced life forms of all?"
"Advanced... huh."
"If eating your own kind is where{n} evolution ends up, then sorry, but{n} I'll take the road of devolution."
"Oh? That is strange."
"After all, do humans not also{n} do things that resemble{n} eating their own kind at times?"
"Killing other people in order to live.{n} Swell that up, and surely you get{n} the system called war."
"Hee hee. Even if you refuse, humans are{n} steadily following the path of evolution.{n} Can you not think of it that way?"
"Advanced... you saay."
"But that is a human yardstick.{n} I think insects are simply{n} living with all their might."
"Yes, with all their might."
"At the very least, those insects{n} do not kill their own kind in a surge of{n} emotion, or kill other creatures for fun."
"Such things they never, ever do."
"Since they lack the learning function{n} called a heart, they are able{n} to stay all the purer."
"Even so, what wonderful beings{n} these creatures called insects are."
"It seems humans must learn{n} a great deal more from insects."
"Tch, he said what he wanted to say{n} and then up and vanished on us."
"But he is a mysterious boy, isn't he."
"What could this sound be?"
"Look out! Something huge{n} is heading this way!"
"Something? What kind of somethiing?"
"Don't ask me!"
"What the!?"
"It's a giant... inseect!?"
"Still, it's way too big! I haven't{n} laid eyes on a monster like this{n} since I came to this island!"
"Could it be!?"
"Could this be another of the ancient{n} weapons called Machine Gods that{n} appeared a hundred years ago!?"
"No, Machine Gods aren't living things.{n} On the outside they look like machines!"
"Besides, 100 years ago at least, no{n} Machine God had a shape like that. I've{n} never seen one in army record photos!"
"Then what?"
"A giant insect like a mantis..."
"But it moves like a person..."
"Call it an Insect Machine Man, I guess!?"
"A Machine Man...!?"
"This thing's an insect,{n} through and through!?"
"Is this a Machine Man... too!?"
"Looks like it..."
"A Machine Man shaped like a giant insect.{n} Right, an Insect Machine Man,{n} you might say!?"
"Looks like... we've got to fight it!"
"Right!"
"Tch! We're on a narrow bridge here!{n} There's not much room to move!{n} Think before you move! Got it!"
"And watch out for those giant scythes!{n} Take one of those head-on and one{n} blow will cut you clean in two!"
"Everyone, we're on a narrow bridge heere!{n} Please move with great care so that{n} you don't jostle one another!"
"And don't get too cloose! Getting cut{n} by the enemy's giant scythes looks{n} like it would hurt veeery much!"
"Lt. {hero:6}! Here I believe it best{n} to post those with guns at the rear{n} and fight spread out, sir!"
"We cannot afford to lose here!{n} Let us show that monster the grit{n} of proud Romulus soldiers!"
"That is truly the Grim Reaper's scythe!{n} A dreadful tool that reaps lives!{n} Please be careful, Mr. {hero:6}!"
"Insects!?"
"Li'l Tethys does not quite know why,{n} but that word gives her a{n} veeery nasty feeling, yes indeed!"
"A scythe that pronounces death..."
"But... my knife is the same...{n} ...My... other name is J.{n} That is... the J in Judgment..."
"On the battlefield... always passing a{n} death sentence... The judge... and{n} also the executioner... That is me..."
"That monster too... I will judge."
"Death sentence..."
"Here, I believe the wisest course is{n} not to approach the enemy carelessly{n} but to attack with magic from afar..."
"I'm an authority on Item Studies, I am!{n} That big scythe looks mighty handy!{n} Why, you could even reap wheat with it!?"
"Insects and we Machine Soldiers are much{n} alike: machines that coldly eliminate{n} outside enemies. Then the terms are even."
"Though it has the form of an insect,{n} that monster has a ki like a person's.{n} The reason is not clear, however."
"Watch me, my prince! With my esper{n} powers I'll turn this mantis monster{n} into a specimen in no time!"
"People often speak of 'mere bugs',{n} yet here the positions are{n} quite reversed, are they not."
"C'mon... c'mon... c'mon..."
"The truth is, yours truly hates bugs!"
"Aaagh! Fine, I just gotta do it, right!?{n} I'll blow it to hell with my heavy MG!"
"Shots of light!?"
"This is bad! Stay on the bridge and{n} we'll be sitting ducks for that fire!"
"It's shooting light!"
"Please be careful: if we stay on the{n} bridge, that fire will pick us off!"
"All right! Keep this up and{n} we finish it in one go!"
"Everyone! Keep it uup!"
"Hurry up and disappear,{n} you mantis bastard!"
"Unlike bugs that learn nothing, we've{n} mastered skills for staying alive!{n} Skills that let humans surpass humans!"
"A power to break past our own limits,{n} one that you, with only the functions{n} you were born with, can never copy!"
"This is the strength of humans!"
"Please forgive us!"
"Forgive us, the sinful creatures{n} called humans, who kill you{n} for the sake of our goal!"
"But we simply cannot live by{n} cutting away our hearts{n} the way that you do..."
"Mm! All thanks to my fine work!{n} Eh? That's right, isn't it!?{n} You were watching, eh, Alice dear?"
"What are you talking about, old man?{n} It's all thanks to{n} Prince {hero:6}'s fine work!"
"You're cruel, Alice dear!{n} Ah well, that's what makes you so cute!"
"Mm! All thanks to my fine work!{n} Eh? That's right, isn't it!?{n} You were watching, eh, Ayame dear?"
"You're cold, Ayame dear!{n} Ah well, that's what makes you so cute!"
"What the hell was that thing!?"
"Could it have been... a person!?"
"Don't be stupid. No way a monster{n} like that could be human!"
"No... of course not..."
"That was a hard battle, wasn't it..."
"Don't talk nonsense. Since we came{n} to this island, has there been{n} one battle that wasn't hard?"
"Yes... that's truue..."
"If we forgot about learning and cut{n} away our feelings like bugs, I bet{n} living would be a lot easier."
"Then no matter how hard the battle,{n} it wouldn't feel hard. It might be{n} surprisingly nice, you know."
"Then we couldn't feel happy things{n} or fun things either.{n} That would be veery saad."
"That's just it."
"Because then we'd never have to{n} feel sadness or loneliness."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
